packageRules.description: GitHub Actions and the tool images their steps run: one PR, only releases at least 3 days old
Merge low-risk Actions updates once CI is green. Not 'digest': for an exact-version pin a new digest means the tag was moved, which needs a look
Base images: CI builds and smoke-tests the image, so digest refreshes and patch updates merge themselves; minor and major updates wait for review
Trivy images were compromised in March 2026 (CVE-2026-33634): own PR, a week's wait, always reviewed
truenas-mcp decides what Claude can do to the NAS (read-only mode): always reviewed
ttyd: the pinned checksums can't be updated automatically
prBodyNotes: Copy `TTYD_SHA256_AMD64` and `TTYD_SHA256_ARM64` in the Dockerfile from this release's `SHA256SUMS` before merging; the build fails until they match.

customManagers.description: Dockerfile ARG versions marked with a '# renovate:' comment; an optional *_COMMIT ARG right below pins the tag to a commit
